closure_claim: Every loss from a wagering transaction for tax year 2025 that the taxpayer (and, on a joint return, the spouse) claims is recorded as an entry as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers gambling losses only: it says nothing about winnings, expenses of wagering, a professional gambler's business, or other Schedule A line 16 deductions. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
title: Gambling loss entries, tax year 2025
